court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before A.P. Sahi, C.J. and Subramonium Prasad, J.)
case_number: W.A.SR No. 33160 of 2013 and CMP No. 25278 of 2019
judgment_text:
C.M.P. No. 25278 of 2019: Civil Miscellaneous Petition is filed to dispense with the production of certified copy of the original order dated 01.11.2012 passed in W.P. No. 24128 of 2012 at present.

W.A.SR No. 33160 of 2013: Writ Appeal filed under Clause 15 of the Letters Patent against the order passed in W.P. No. 24128 of 2012 dated 01.11.2012.

The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

A.P. Sahi, C.J.:— The writ appeal was presented without certified copy of original order.

2. No counsel is present to make any request in this behalf.

3. Therefore, the writ appeal, on account of the said defect and also for want of prosecution, is dismissed at the SR stage itself.

4. Accordingly, the writ appeal is consigned to records. No costs.
